senses.gloss:
ऽज -ज (vb. जन्), latter part of comp. words, m., f. जा, and n.
 1. Born, son, daughter, e. g. गूढ- (vb. गुह्), Born secretly. m. A son of concealed birth, Yājñ. 2, 129. धृतराष्ट्र-जा, f. A daughter of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, MBh. 14, 2285. आत्मज, i. e. आत्मन्-, A son, Hit. 41, 21. जघन्य-, adj. Youngest, MBh. 1, 804. देह-, m. A son, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 3. पूर्व-, m. pl. Ancestors, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 7.
 2. Produced, Man. 1, 87; Bhāṣāp. 62.
 3. Caused, Nal. 4, 13.
 --Cf. also धर्म-,
 I. adj. Begotten from a sense of duty, Man. 9, 107.
 II. m. Son of Dharma, a name of Arjuna, Bhāg. P. 3, 3, 16.
